				limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_4 }
				complete_mission = jxp_map_mission_ukt_kojima_port
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_5 }
				complete_mission = jxp_map_mission_ukt_bizen_crafts
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_6 }
				complete_mission = jxp_map_mission_ukt_naoie_household
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_1
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_2
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_3
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_4
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_5
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_old_progress_6
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_replay_guard
		clr_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_migration_pending
		set_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_migration_v014
	}

	option = { name = "OK" }
}
